sources_considered.why: Original January report contains cross-domain results and explicit limitations for DeepSeek-R1.
December evaluations document improvements beyond math and coding.
Read for the earlier comparison, but the abstract does not establish a common measure of breadth across the transitions.

evidence_items.locator: Section 5, General Capability; related results in sections 1.2 and 3.1
evidence_items.explanation: These limitations support the selective-improvement reading. However, the same report also describes gains in factual questions, document analysis, writing, and open-domain answering, so it does not establish that improvements were narrowly confined.
The factuality evaluations provide material evidence of benefits beyond math and coding. They do not by themselves establish an advance comparable in breadth to the earlier GPT transitions.

unresolved_gaps: No common cross-generation evaluation establishes the claimed difference in breadth.
The evidence contains both nontechnical improvements and important regressions.
The available comparisons do not isolate inference compute from training changes.
